import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[] lsc = new long[62];
    static long[] rsc = new long[62];
    static long[] rsc2 = new long[62];
    static char[] s = new char[62];
    static Map<Pair, Long> nm = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<Pair, Long> mm = new HashMap<>();

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;
        
        Pair(long first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
        
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return first == pair.first && second == pair.second;
        }
        
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static long comb(int n, int k) {
        if (n < k || k < 0)
            return 0;
        long rez = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            rez = rez * (n - i) / (i + 1);
        }
        return rez;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int r = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        String input = sc.next();
        s = input.toCharArray();
        
        int n = 2 * (r + c);
        
        lsc[2 * r - 1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2 * r; i < n; i++) {
            lsc[i] = lsc[i - 1] * i / (1L * i - 1L * 2 * r + 1L);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            rsc[i] = comb(i, r);
            rsc2[i] = comb(i, r - 1);
        }
        
        long nsum = rsc[n / 2] * rsc[n / 2];
        long msum = 0;
        int cnta = 0, cntb = 0;
        
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int ok;
            if (msum > 0)
                ok = 1;
            else
                ok = 0;
            if (cntb == n / 2)
                ok = 1;
            if (cnta == n / 2)
                ok = 0;
            
            if (ok == 1) {
                cnta++;
                msum = msum - rsc2[n / 2 - cnta] * rsc[n / 2 - cntb];
            } else {
                cntb++;
                msum = msum + rsc2[n / 2 - cntb] * rsc[n / 2 - cnta];
            }
        }
        
        msum = Math.max(msum, -msum);
        
        mm.clear();
        mm.put(new Pair(0, 0), 1L);
        
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 2 * r - 1; i--) {
            nm.clear();
            
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mm.entrySet()) {
                long sum = entry.getKey().first;
                long ncnt = entry.getValue();
                int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
                
                int ast = n / 2 - cnt;
                int bst = i + 1 - ast;
                long asum = sum + rsc2[ast - 1] * rsc[bst];
                long bsum = sum - rsc2[bst - 1] * rsc[ast];
                
                if (s[i] == 'A') {
                    Pair p1 = new Pair(asum, cnt + 1);
                    nm.put(p1, nm.getOrDefault(p1, 0L) + ncnt);
                    Pair p2 = new Pair(bsum, cnt);
                    nm.put(p2, nm.getOrDefault(p2, 0L) + 0L);
                } else if (s[i] == 'B') {
                    Pair p1 = new Pair(asum, cnt + 1);
                    nm.put(p1, nm.getOrDefault(p1, 0L) + 0L);
                    Pair p2 = new Pair(bsum, cnt);
                    nm.put(p2, nm.getOrDefault(p2, 0L) + ncnt);
                } else {
                    Pair p1 = new Pair(asum, cnt + 1);
                    nm.put(p1, nm.getOrDefault(p1, 0L) + ncnt);
                    Pair p2 = new Pair(bsum, cnt);
                    nm.put(p2, nm.getOrDefault(p2, 0L) + ncnt);
                }
            }
            
            nsum = nsum - lsc[i];
            mm.clear();
            
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : nm.entrySet()) {
                long sum = entry.getKey().first;
                long ncnt = entry.getValue();
                int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
                
                int ast = n / 2 - cnt;
                int bst = i - ast;
                
                if (cnt > n / 2 || n - i - cnt > n / 2)
                    continue;
                if (sum < -msum - rsc[ast] * rsc[bst] || sum > msum + rsc[ast] * rsc[bst])
                    continue;
                
                Pair p = new Pair(sum, cnt);
                mm.put(p, mm.getOrDefault(p, 0L) + ncnt);
            }
        }
        
        long bsum = (long) 1e18;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mm.entrySet()) {
            long val = Math.max(entry.getKey().first, -entry.getKey().first);
            bsum = Math.min(bsum, val);
        }
        
        long rasp = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mm.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            long ncnt = entry.getValue();
            int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
            
            if (sum == bsum || sum == -bsum) {
                int sem = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 2 * r - 1; i++) {
                    if (s[i] == '?')
                        sem++;
                    else if (s[i] == 'A')
                        cnt++;
                }
                ncnt = ncnt * comb(sem, n / 2 - cnt);
                rasp += ncnt;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(rasp);
    }
}
